capability.description: Stable kebab-case name of the skill, tool contract, or workflow.

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path covered by tree_sha.

tree_sha.description: Full 40-character Git tree or blob SHA from git rev-parse HEAD:<path> at verification time.

verified_at.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the latest state transition.

verifier.description: Named person or independent review role that signed this state.

evidence.description: Sanitized summary of the live execution and independent check.
